name: tacty
description: Tacty gives any business a digital loyalty card: customers tap an NFC tag or scan a QR code and save it to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. With the Tacty plugin, ChatGPT creates the card, explains who is coming and who the business is losing, and sends notices to customers' cards after the owner confirms.

interface.shortDescription: Loyalty cards via NFC and QR
interface.longDescription:
Tacty gives any business a digital loyalty card: customers tap an NFC tag or scan a QR code and save it to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, with nothing to download.

With Tacty in ChatGPT you can:
- Create your card by chatting: stamps, points, a welcome coupon or a member discount, plus the QR code to print.
- Understand your business: who your best customers are, who you are losing based on each customer's own visit rhythm, and your busiest and slowest hours.
- Act on it: send a notice to your customers' cards, publish a promotion, or turn on automatic nudges like "we miss you" or "birthday". ChatGPT always asks you to confirm before messaging your customers.

Resellers who sell Tacty to local businesses can also manage their whole portfolio and switch to a demo café with realistic sample data to show what Tacty does.

Sign in with your Tacty account. New businesses get a 14-day free trial.
defaultPrompt: Create a loyalty card for my barbershop: 8 haircuts and the 9th is free.
Which customers am I losing? Send them a nudge to come back.
What are my slowest hours? Create a promotion for them.

positive.description: Demo mode: monthly summary of the demo café.
positive.prompt: Let's go into demo mode. How did the café do in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Enters the demo café and summarizes visits, active customers, new customers, repeat rate and rewards for the last 30 days, noting it is sample data.

positive.description: Customers at risk, based on each customer's own visit rhythm.
positive.prompt: Let's go into demo mode. Which customers are we losing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists customers who have been away longer than their usual rhythm, with how many days late they are, and offers to send them a nudge (asking for confirmation before sending).

positive.description: Top customers and how often they come.
positive.prompt: Let's go into demo mode. Who are our 10 best customers and how often do they come?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top customers by visits in the last 90 days with their visit cadence in days and days since their last visit.

positive.description: Slow hours and a promotion for them.
positive.prompt: Let's go into demo mode. What are our slowest hours? Create a promotion for them.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows visits by hour and weekday, names the slowest hours, proposes a promotion text and creates it after the user confirms.

positive.description: Set up a new business with its loyalty card and QR code.
positive.prompt: Create a new barbershop called Barbería Norte with a loyalty card: 8 haircuts and the 9th is free. Then give me its QR code to print.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the business and a stamps card with 8 visits and the reward 'Free haircut', then creates a QR point and returns the print_url to print the QR code.

negative.description: Request for an action Tacty does not offer: deleting all customer data in bulk.
Request for data from a business the account does not have access to.
negative.prompt: Show me the customers of business biz_doesnotexist123.

negative.description: Unrelated question that should not trigger Tacty tools.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

publication.release_notes: First release: create loyalty cards (stamps, points, coupon, discount), get business insights (top customers, customers at risk, best times), send Wallet notices, manage automations, and a demo mode for resellers.

es-419.subtitle: Tarjetas de lealtad NFC y QR
es-419.description:
Tacty le da a cualquier negocio una tarjeta de fidelización digital: sus clientes tocan un tag NFC o escanean un QR y la guardan en Apple Wallet o Google Wallet, sin descargar nada.

Con Tacty en ChatGPT puedes:
- Crear tu tarjeta conversando: sellos, puntos, cupón de bienvenida o descuento de socio, y el código QR para imprimir.
- Entender tu negocio: quiénes son tus mejores clientes, a quién estás perdiendo según el ritmo de visita de cada uno, y tus horas más fuertes y más flojas.
- Actuar: mandar un aviso a la tarjeta de tus clientes, publicar una promoción o encender avisos automáticos como «te extrañamos» o «cumpleaños». ChatGPT siempre te pide confirmación antes de escribirle a tus clientes.

Los resellers que venden Tacty a negocios locales también pueden manejar toda su cartera y entrar a un café demo con datos de ejemplo para mostrar lo que hace Tacty.

Entra con tu cuenta de Tacty. Los negocios nuevos tienen 14 días gratis.
